text: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included(Photocopy of valid passport identification page. Passport must be an ordinary passport and be valid for at least six months. Applicants currently residing in China must include a copy of the page containing a valid visa or residence permit.) * 2. 2-inch photo Photo format: color 2-inch bareheaded photo, white background without border, head takes up 2/3 of the photo size, photo size is not less than 320*240 pixels, aspect ratio is 4:3, size is 100-500kb, JPG format. * 3. English Language test result TOEFL or IELTS or other English Learning Certificates; * 4. Notarized highest education certificate(this year's graduates provide proof of pregraduation). Your recent diploma.Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. * 5. Physical Examination Form(only valid for 6 months) Incomplete records or those without the signature of the attending physician, the official stamp of the hospital or a sealed photograph of the applicants are invalid. Please carefully plan your physical examination schedule as the result is valid for only six months (your results should be valid when you submit your application). *Please be advised that all the health information provided in the Foreigner Physical Examination Form is true and accurate. Please note that any intentional concealment or misrepresentation of health conditions will be considered a serious issue of integrity, which may lead to the rejection of the application or the revocation of any obtained admission eligibility. You can download a template or sample from here . * 6. Notarized highest education academic transcript Documents in languages other than Chinese or English must be attached with translated English or Chinese version. Applicants must present the original cope of the aforementioned documents when registering at ZJSU. * 7. Police Certificate * 8. Confirmation signature I promise that all the information in my application form and all my application materials are true. If there is any falsehood, I will voluntarily bear the corresponding consequences and be disqualified from admission or expelled from academic status. I agree to upload my signature to confirm. Note: the signature must be from the applicant himself or herself. * 9. CV -Submit a resume or CV to help the university better understand your background. -Written in Chinese or in English. Your resume must include a complete and continuous list of your education and work experience, covering all periods up to the time you apply to university, without missing a single year or month. -Some universities may require you to use their designated CV templates, which must be downloaded and completed accordingly. * 10. Study Plan or Personal Statement in Chinese or English. * 11. Enrollment Test Please do the test on: https://www.wjx.cn/vj/hWcm2QG.aspx Please send us the screenshot after you finished it. * 12. Psychological Health Test Please do the test on: https://www.wjx.cn/vm/YOsHCxP.aspx Please send us the screenshot after you finished it. * 13. Self-introduction (recorded in video) Videos in mp4, wmv avi, flv, rmvb format are accepted. * 14. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. You can download a template or sample from here . Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
